title: Flat finite modules over valuation algebras are finitely presented
statement: Let $A$ be a valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring], meaning an integral domain whose fraction field $K$ has $a\in A$ or $a^{-1}\in A$ for every $a\in K^\times$. Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism which is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. If $M$ is a finite $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] that is flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $M$ is finitely presented as a $B$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0GSE (lemma-valuation-ring-flat-essentially-finite-type), part (2), statement and proof at lines 6005--6044

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], write B as W^{-1}C for a finite type A-algebra C and multiplicative set W. Choose a surjection P=A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow C from [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and let rho:P\to B be the composite. For q=rho^{-1}(m_B), every element outside q maps to a unit of the local ring B, so rho factors through P_q\to B. Every fraction c/w in B has c and w represented by p,s in P, and w is a unit because s\notin q; hence P_q\to B is surjective. The map P_q\to B makes B a finite type P_q-algebra.

Choose a finite surjection $P_q^{\oplus r}\twoheadrightarrow M$, possible because $M$ is finite over $B$ and hence over $P_q$, and let $K$ be its kernel, so $0\to K\to P_q^{\oplus r}\to M\to0$ is exact. Let $L\subseteq P^{\oplus r}$ be the inverse image of $K$ under $P^{\oplus r}\to P_q^{\oplus r}$. By [lem-trf-module-submodule-localization], $K=L_q$. Therefore the induced map $N=P^{\oplus r}/L\to M$ is injective, so $N$ is a $P$-submodule of $M$.

The module M is flat over the domain A, so it is torsion-free by [lem-trf-flat-module-torsionfree-domain]. Its P-submodule N is therefore torsion-free, hence flat over the valuation ring A by [lem-trf-valuation-torsionfree-flat]. Since N is finite over the finite type A-algebra P, [lem-trf-valuation-finite-type-module-presentation] gives that N is finitely presented as a P-module.

Localize a finite presentation of N at q. By [lem-trf-localization-preserves-finite-presentation], N_q is finitely presented as a P_q-module. Exactness of localization [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-exact] applied to 0\to L\to P^{\oplus r}\to N\to0 identifies N_q with M. Since P_q\to B is of finite type by Step 1, [lem-trf-finitely-presented-over-subring] upgrades finite presentation of M over P_q to finite presentation over B.
